digest.component_or_area: documentation and author guidance for file-impact declaration
propositions: Three authenticated file-impact states (undeclared, paths, none) are implemented in reducer but documented incompletely across four author-facing locations

The tri-state semantics—undeclared as unscoped, paths as dependency-scoped with files, none as authenticated empty set with substantive reason—must be documented consistently in gate, ticket-model, event-schema, and packaged author guide

Public `rebar explain plan` entry point must communicate the three choices, the set-file-impact command, the distinction that docs-only and test-only work use paths, and the advisory LLM no-file-impact criterion with reason structure
Documentation must specify exact replacement and clearing semantics for every state transition and the material-fingerprint effect on plan-review attestation

RED-first public CLI test validates discoverable tri-state contract through observable stdout without source-grepping or private-implementation coupling; separate manual semantic checklist audits standalone docs against implementation evidence
